description: Owner approvals of hurtbox and hitbox bodies. Not written by a tool: the project owner said it in chat and an agent transcribed it here (an agent never approves). Each entry binds to the sha256 of the body without its `review` block (bodyDigest in game/tools/lib/kiln-contract.ts), so editing a box voids the approval (the build fails on a digest mismatch). `digests` maps an asset id to that digest; `no_body` lists the VS ids the owner reviewed that have no collision body, each with the reason the draft tool gave. An approved body lives in assets/bodies/<id>.bodies.json with review.status owner-approved and review.approvalRef set to the entry id.
